anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.anvil.text_1: The anvil is the foundation for all processing in the AnvilCraft
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.anvil.text_2: The anvil falls from a height to complete one anvil process
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.block_comparato: When the blocks on either side of the comparator are the same, it’ll send out a signal
Right-click to turn on precise mode—it’ll check super carefully if the blocks are exactly the same
When the Block Devourer receives the Redstone signal, it will try to destroy the cube in the 3x3 space ahead
The Block Devourer can place the destroyed blocks into the chest back at the back
Only a very small portion of the world's base blocks will be retained
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.block_devourer_: The Block Devourer can destroy larger blocks based on the height from which the anvil falls, with a maximum area of 9x9
When a downward-facing block devourer is hit by an anvil, it will move down one block at the same time
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.block_placer.te: Block Placer can place blocks in front of it when powered by redstone
It can also read the items in the container
If the block placer is blocked by a mob, it will not place the block
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.block_placer_an: Block Placer can place blocks with anvil
The higher the anvil falls, the farther the blocks are placed. The farthest is 5 grids
When the placer is followed by another placer, they can share containers
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.block_process.t: When the anvil hits the spawner, it will be forced to work
But there are still constraints, such as light, number of mob
The higher the height of the anvil, the higher the probability of success
When the anvil strikes the red stone, a red stone EMP occurs, extinguishing the nearby red stone torches for an instant
The higher the anvil falls, the larger the range
Press the lead into the vault to reset it
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.block_recipe.te: When the anvil hits a specific block, the block is crushed
When the anvil hits the block with an item on it, press the item into the block
When the anvil hit the block on the stone cutter, the block was destroyed
The Royal Anvil can precisely destroy blocks
The Ember Anvil can melt blocks
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.bulging.text_1: When the cauldron is full of water, it will bulge the items inside
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.chute_basics.te: A normal funnel can only transmit one item at a time
Whereas chutes can transfer a set of items at once
and can be thrown as drops
When the chute output position is blocked by a block, the item will stop outputting
When there is an identical set of drops under the chute, the item will not continue to be thrown
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.chute_filtering: Right-click the chute to open the filter settings interface
Set it allow only diamonds to pass through
The chute will only let the set item pass through and will not absorb items outside of the filter condition
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.cooking.text_1: Using the cauldron with the campfire to process items
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.cooking.text_2: If there is water in the cauldron, another recipe can be performed
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.dectruction_mod: Another mode of shock: Destruction Mode
When a heavy iron block is surrounded on four sides by anvils, it triggers the destruction mode of shock.
Regardless of the chosen target, the breaking effect changes with the base anvils.
Hay blocks at the corners make Shock harvest crops and replant them automatically.
When the corners are logs, Shock breaks entire trees, as well as huge fungi stems, cacti, sugar canes, chorus plants, and other large plants.
For continuously growing crops, plant them one block below Shock’s plane to prevent being uprooted.
Changing the blocks at the four corners can change the destruction targets
When the base corners are obsidian, shock breaks any breakable block.
When the four sides are Royal Anvils, Shock gains Silk Touch effect.
When the four sides are Ember Anvils, Shock gains Auto-Smelting effect.
Here, stone drops cobblestone when destroyed, which is then smelted back into stone
When the four sides are transcendence anvils, Shock gains Fortune V effect.
In Shock’s base, a spectral anvil functions as a regular anvil.
When the corners are grass blocks, Shock breaks flowers, snow layers, and other attachments.
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.get_corrupted_b: Beacons have a probability of being transformed
The bigger the base, the higher the probability
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.get_giant_anvil: The more anvils you give to zombies, the greater the probability that they will be transformed into giants carrying giant anvils
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.heater.header: Use heater to execute the high-heat recipe
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.heater.text_1: It requires 16 kW of power to work in the grid
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.heater.text_2: The heater is now working properly
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.heater.text_3: Drop some raw minerals into the cauldron...
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.heater.text_4: Use an anvil or the Anvil Hammer to strike the cauldron
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.heater.text_5: It will execute the high-heat recipe
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.impact_pile.hea: Use Impact Pile to generate Mineral Fountain
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.impact_pile.tex: Impact piles are consumables used to create a mineral fountain
To work properly, it must be placed no higher than 8 blocks above the world’s bottom
And it must be placed on bedrock or deepslate
Then strike it with an undamaged anvil dropped from at least 20 blocks high
When the conditions are met, the anvil and the impact pile will be consumed...
and a mineral fountain will be generated
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.iron_trapdoor.h: Use Iron Trapdoor to trigger unpack Recipe
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.iron_trapdoor.t: You can use the iron trapdoor to disassemble composite items into their components
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.item_crush.head: Crush Items
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.item_crush.text: The crushing table can crush items
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.magnet.header: Use magnet to attract the anvil
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.magnet.text_1: The anvil needs to be lifted and fallen for processing
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.magnet.text_3: Magnet will stop working when it receives a redstone signal
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.magnet_magnetiz: Get a magnet ingot through a hollow magnet block
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.magnet_power_ge: Generate electricity by rubbing a magnet and a copper block
When a magnet is pushed against adjacent copper blocks, it generates electric charges
Use a collector to absorb the electric charges on the magnet
Copper rust can affect the production of electric charges
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.magnetic_chute_: A normal chute drops items directly downward
Magnetic chutes attract items from behind and propel them forward
When items are ejected, they're given forward momentum
Regular chutes still transform into simple chutes when connected to magnetic chutes
But magnetic chutes don't transform into simple chutes when connected to other magnetic chutes
Right-click the magnetic chute to open the filter settings interface
Set it to allow only diamonds to pass through
The magnetic chute will only let the set item pass through and will not absorb items outside of the filter condition
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.mode_of_shock.h: Blocks around the Heavy Iron Block determines Shock mode
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.mode_of_shock.t: Changing the blocks surrounding the Heavy Iron Block can alter the Shock mode
For example, resin block can make anvils within the shock range bounce upward once
Placing Cursed Gold Blocks on the four sides can add equal additional damage to the shock damage
Placing different gem blocks at the four corners can add various types of damage
For example, Ruby Blocks can add fire damage
Sapphire Blocks can add freezing damage
Topaz Blocks can add lightning damage
Void Matter Blocks can add armor-piercing void damage
Very suitable for executing tons of monsters.
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.powered_sliding: Without redstone signal, powered sliding rail acts like a sliding rail stop for items and blocks
But living entities like parrots are not affected by the powered rail
Items and blocks passing over will be attracted and stopped
When powered with redstone, it accelerates items and pushes blocks forward
The FallDistance of Giant Anvil determines the shock range
Giant Anvil falls 3m can shock an area of 25m²
And Giant Anvil falls 16m can shock an area of 1089m²
Additionally, shock damage increases with the FallDistance of Giant Anvil
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.shock.text_1: When a giant anvil falls onto a heavy iron block
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.shock.text_2: It unleashes a shockwave ripples outward in all directions
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.shock.text_3: The shockwave harms any creature not wearing shoes
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.simple_chute.te: When one chute is connected to the output direction of another chute, it becomes a simple chute
The simple chute can receive items from other chutes from multiple directions
Normal chutes are locked by redstone signals
The simple chute will not be locked by the redstone signal
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.sliding_rail_bl: Blocks can also slide on sliding rails when pushed by pistons
Slime blocks can stick multiple blocks together to form a sliding structure
However, blocks that cannot be pushed by pistons also cannot slide on rails
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.sliding_rail_it: Sliding rails have extremely smooth surfaces that allow items to slide without friction
Items can slide infinitely far until they reach the end of the rail or are collected
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.sliding_rail_st: Sliding rail stops have a powerful suction that can pull in any entity passing above it.
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.space_overcompr: Use the Space Overcompressor to create the Neutronium Ingot
Press a large amount of metal items into the Space Overcompressor to accumulate mass
When the Space Overcompressor has built up enough mass, a neutron ingot will form
Neutron ingot can pass through most blocks, so you'll need something like end dust to stop it
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.stamping.text_1: The stamping platform can stamp items
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.tag.logistics_c: Various item transfer and storage components
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.tag.magnet_bloc: Use magnet to attract the anvil
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.time_warp.text_: Corrupted Beacons can execute time warp recipe
anvilcraft_ponder.ponder.transmission_po: Use Transmission Pole to transmitting electricity
Powered sliding rail with rail stop
When there's a sliding rail stop behind, it pulls items and blocks from the stop and accelerates them forward
